resources.string: Connect a playlist from your IPTV provider, import a file, or open a stream.
Tap the heart beside a channel to keep it here.
Start watching and your history will appear here.
Try another search, category or playlist.
Choose how you want to connect. Get the playlist URL or Xtream credentials from your provider.
This app is a player. It does not include TV channels or sell IPTV subscriptions. Add content you are authorized to access.
Remove “%1$s”, its channels, favorites and history from this device?
No programme data. Update EPG in Playlists or add a matching XMLTV URL. Channel IDs must match the guide.

Connect your phone and Chromecast / Google Cast TV to the same Wi-Fi. The TV must be able to reach the stream URL and support its format. Local files and streams requiring custom HTTP headers cannot be sent with the default receiver.
Paste a provider URL, sign in with Xtream Codes, or choose an M3U file. Your content stays in your hands.
Browse live TV, movies and series. Search by name, save favorites, and return to recent watching.
Take it to the big screen
Watch on your phone or connect a Google Cast TV on the same Wi-Fi. Use the sleep timer and playback controls to make it yours.
Enter a valid http:// or https:// URL. For Xtream, use the server address, not player_api.php.
No playable channels found. Check that this is a playlist or that your account has content.
Access denied. Check your credentials, subscription and provider restrictions.
Could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
The file is too large. Use a playlist under 50 MB or an EPG under 100 MB when unpacked.
The provider returned an unsupported response. Check the server URL and try again.
Could not read this TV guide. Check the XMLTV URL and programme dates.
Choose a supported video, audio or image file.
Could not read the playlist or saved data. Check file access and format. Local HLS files require the original online URL.
This stream could not be played. Check your connection, URL, provider access or supported codecs.
Unable to play on this TV
No compatible app found. Install a media player and try again.
Access denied. Check your provider account, subscription or connection limit.
This stream no longer exists. Refresh the playlist or contact your provider.
This device cannot play the stream format or codec. Try another quality or an external player.
The stream requires a DRM license that this player cannot obtain.
The file is unavailable. Choose the file again and check access permission.
Phone and TV on the same Wi-Fi
No playlist yet? Ask your IPTV provider for an M3U link or Xtream login. Channels are supplied by your provider.
Save channels with the heart. Movies and episodes remember where you stopped.
For Cast, connect both devices to one Wi-Fi network and choose a TV with the Cast button.
Paste the M3U or M3U8 playlist link supplied by your provider.
Use the server address, username and password supplied by your IPTV provider.
Choose an M3U or M3U Plus playlist saved on your device.
Open a direct HLS, DASH or video URL. A website page is not a stream URL.
Choose a video, audio recording or image from this device.
A TV guide is optional. We will detect its URL when it is included in your playlist.
The file picker opens next. Access is saved only after you confirm the import.
Reading your source… This may take a moment for large playlists.
Source content was read successfully. Individual streams are checked when you play them.
The address or file type is ready. Playback and codec compatibility have not been tested yet.
TV guide source detected. Download the guide in Playlists.
A few titles from your source
Nothing has been added yet. Confirm to save this source, or go back to edit it.
Browse your playlists and find something to watch.
Move with the arrows. Press OK to open.
Already have a playlist? Connect it to see your channels here.
Sample playlists from iptv-org on GitHub. Choose one to download and preview its channels.
Community playlists change over time. Some channels may be unavailable or restricted in your region.
